Or point it at any URL and let an AI drive a real browser to record the whole demo for you, then add the cinematic touches (3D moves, spotlights, callouts). [...] Prefer full control? There's a deep editor with manual zoom keyframes. Live in the terminal? Screenify now speaks MCP — connect it once and Claude, Claude Code, or Cursor can record, style, and hand you the finished video — plus a JSON-speaking CLI if you'd rather script it yourself.

Everything runs on-device on Apple Silicon — nothing uploaded. Free to start; you only upgrade when you genuinely need higher-quality exports and the more advanced features.

Would love your feedback — what do you use for product demos today? Happy to nerd out about the 3D pipeline, the MCP server, or the AI web-record under the hood.

results.title: 14 Best Product Demo Video Makers in 2026 | ngram.com
results.content:
Screen Studio is a Mac-only screen recording tool trusted by thousands of professionals for creating polished product demos. What makes it stand out is the automatic post-processing: smooth cursor movement, automatic zoom on interactions, device framing, and background customization.

You record once, and Screen Studio handles the polish. It detects your device model, replaces cursors with high-resolution versions, normalizes voice volume, removes background noise, and can generate subtitles from a transcript.

The trade-off is clear: Screen Studio only runs on macOS, and it's a recording/polish tool, not a full video editor. If you need multi-scene editing, motion graphics, or AI-generated content, you'll need to pair it with another tool.
